adjudication.rationale: In `packages/core/CalendarManager.ts`, `createEvent` now returns `externalId` only from the new optional parameter (`externalId?: string`). In `packages/core/EventManager.ts` `createAllCalendarEvents`, the branch for destinations without `destination.credentialId` calls `createEvent(c, event)` without passing `destination.externalId`, so `result.externalId` will be `undefined` for that path. Meanwhile, `EventManager` now writes booking references using `externalCalendarId: isCalendarType ? result.externalId : undefined` (around the changed lines ~169-170 and ~208), so legacy/credential-less calendar events will lose the `externalCalendarId` they previously derived from `evt.destinationCalendar?.externalId`. That is a verifiable behavioral regression and can break later update/delete/reschedule flows that depend on the stored external calendar id.
